scoring_justification: Agent reports Tc values; compare each to paper reference with absolute tolerance 10 K.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference Tc values for each target phase
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg Tc values)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text; mP23-Na7/8BC 88 K, oP22-Na3/4BC 84 K, oS32-Na2/3BC 43 K, oS48-Mg4/5B2C2 57 K, hP7-Mg2/3B2C2 73 K
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported numbers from the source paper.

schema.description: Array of objects each containing the phase identifier and the computed superconducting critical temperature Tc in Kelvin.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature Tc (in K) for the five target phases computed with anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory using μ*=0.20.

output_contract.notes: The target phases are oS48-Mg4/5B2C2, hP7-Mg2/3B2C2, mP23-Na7/8BC, oP22-Na3/4BC, and oS32-Na2/3BC. The scoring compares each Tc value to a hidden reference with a fixed absolute tolerance; no directionality is assumed.
